Payment Terms: 100% payment will be released by the consignee in accordance w ith GeM terms and conditions, after receipt of the furniture in good and acceptable co ndition along with the inspection note at the destination. 6. The seller shall provide a comprehensive three-year guarantee against manufactur ing defects. The guarantee period will commence from the date of receipt of goods a t the destination. 7. The tenderer shall submit an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) 3% of estimated price which is ₹13,500/- in the form of a Demand Draft issued by SBI Bank / any Nationaliz ed Bank, drawn in favour of “PRINCIPAL, Government MCA College”. The original De mand Draft shall be submitted at the College along with the required details before t he last date of bid submission. 9. If EMD exemption is applicable, the bidder shall upload the required supporting do cuments on GeM, as prescribed under the Gujarat Purchase Policy, 2024, including a valid NSIC/CSPO certificate and UDYAM Registration Certificate. 10. If Turnover and Experience exemption is applicable to Start-up agencies, the req uired documents as per the Gujarat Purchase Policy, 2024 (DPIIT, NSIC/CSPO and UD YAM Certificate) shall be submitted and uploaded on GeM. 11. The ePBG / Security Deposit amount 5% of estimated price, ₹22,500/- shall be su
bmitted in favour of “PRINCIPAL, Government MCA College” upon acceptance of the t ender. The agency shall furnish an undertaking to this effect. .
